name: Nashik
description: Major horticulture & onion hub in North Maharashtra; prone to market price volatility and localized dry spells.

name: Akola
description: Historically rainfed cotton-soybean belt in Vidarbha with high climate sensitivity and groundwater deficit.

name: Yavatmal
description: Critical rainfed agrarian zone with high informal credit dependency and seasonal rainfall breaks.

name: Kalahandi
description: South-western Odisha rainfed paddy and pulse pocket subject to periodic mid-season dry spells.

name: Balangir
description: Drought-vulnerable belt with high concentration of smallholders dependent on monsoon rainfall.

name: Bargarh
description: Rice bowl of Western Odisha with Hirakud canal command network and high paddy productivity.

name: Nagaon
description: Central Brahmaputra Valley agro-zone with mixed rice-jute cropping systems and seasonal flood risk.

name: Golaghat
description: Upper Assam fertile floodplains characterized by paddy, tea, and sugarcane production.

name: Barpeta
description: Lower Assam char areas and riverine belts prone to flash waterlogging and soil erosion.

name: Raichur
description: North Karnataka dryland tract with major cotton, paddy, and sunflower acreage subject to drought.

name: Belagavi
description: Transition agro-climatic zone supporting sugarcane, maize, and soybean cultivation.

name: Dharwad
description: Hub of agricultural research and pulse-oilseed production in Northern Karnataka.

name: Varanasi
description: Eastern UP Gangetic plain with intensive paddy-wheat-vegetable cropping.

name: Prayagraj
description: Confluence agro-zone supporting pulses, wheat, and guava cultivation.

name: Gorakhpur
description: Terai transition zone supporting sugarcane and paddy cultivation.
